tasks.title: Project Architecture Analysis
tasks.description: Analyze current epic implementations and create detailed architecture documentation
tasks.details: Review all 5 epics (1,2,3,4,6) to understand current models, views, and frontend implementations. Document existing database schemas, API endpoints, and frontend components.
tasks.testStrategy: Create comprehensive documentation review checklist

tasks.title: Unified Database Schema Design
tasks.description: Design consolidated database schema for all epics with proper relationships
tasks.details: Create unified models for User, Company, Job entities. Design epic-specific models with proper foreign key relationships. Plan migration strategy for existing data.
tasks.testStrategy: Schema validation and relationship integrity tests

tasks.title: Django Project Structure Setup
tasks.description: Create unified Django backend project structure
tasks.details: Set up new Django project with apps for each epic. Configure settings for different environments. Set up proper project structure with shared utilities.
tasks.testStrategy: Project structure validation and import tests

tasks.title: User Authentication System

tasks.testStrategy: Authentication flow testing, security testing

tasks.title: Epic 2 API Endpoints - Resume Management

tasks.title: Epic 3 API Endpoints - Resume Feedback

tasks.title: Epic 4 API Endpoints - Certification Roadmap
